headline: BLAND (PROP) extends its 5‑day surge, posting a +5.63% opening gap amid an AGM resolution filing.
market_take: Today's coverage shows heightened volatility across sectors, with 57 unusual‑trading alerts (20 high) and several price‑gap moves. Food stocks led the downside, notably XBIO (-11.11% open gap) and AQUA (-9.09% open gap), each accompanied by high‑impact filings. Property displayed mixed signals: BLAND rallied strongly, while PF and RML slipped sharply. Volume spikes were evident in CONMAT (VNG +4.14x) and AGRI (UVAN 4.7σ).

BLAND posted a +5.63% opening gap and filed an AGM resolution, reinforcing its 5‑day +55.6% rally. PF fell -20.00% and RML dropped -11.11% despite modest volume increases.
